name: 21 Jump Street
description: 21 Jump Street revolves around a group of young cops who would use their youthful appearance to go undercover and solve crimes involving teenagers and young adults.

videos.title: Pilot (1)
videos.overview: Hanson gets assigned to the Jump Street unit, a special division of the police force which uses young cops to go undercover and stop juvenile crime. His first case involves catching drug dealers.

videos.title: Pilot (2)
videos.overview: Hanson gets assigned to the Jump Street unit, a special division of the police force which uses young cops to go undercover and stop juvenile crime. His first case involves catching drug dealers.

videos.title: America, What a Town
videos.overview: Hoffs goes undercover to keep a wild Eastern Bloc exchange student out of trouble. Hanson and Penhall enroll in a shop class suspected of being a chop shop for an auto theft ring.

videos.title: Don't Pet the Teacher
videos.overview: A woman with car trouble, whom Hanson helps out and makes a date with, turns out to be a teacher who has been getting threatening messages and whose class he has been assigned to undercover.

videos.title: My Future's So Bright, I Gotta Wear Shades
videos.overview: Hanson and Penhall infiltrate an exclusive preppie clique to investigate a prank that left a girl dead.

videos.title: The Worst Night of Your Life
videos.overview: Hoffs is not convinced that the captured suspect in an arson case at a Catholic girls school is the guilty party and believes that the real culprit will strike again at the school's prom.

videos.title: Gotta Finish the Riff
videos.overview: Jenko is killed by a drunk driver and is replaced by Captain Fuller who has his hands full dealing with a vengeful gang leader whom has taken his principal and several others hostage, including an undercover Hanson.

videos.title: Bad Influence
videos.overview: Hanson and Penhall try to locate some missing juveniles, while Ioki tries to find a link between a teenage prostitution ring and a series of burglaries.

videos.title: Blindsided
videos.overview: The daughter of a policeman who claims her father is sexually abusing her tries to hire Hanson—undercover with Penhall as one of the drug dealing McQuaid brothers—to kill her father.

videos.title: Next Generation
videos.overview: Hanson, who is out to catch a loan shark, finds his cover threatened when his high school quiz team makes it to the semi-finals, which are to be broadcast on TV.

videos.title: Low and Away
videos.overview: Penhall joins the school baseball team in order to keep an eye on one of its star players, whose life has been threatened when his father agrees to testify against the mob.

videos.title: 16 Blown to 35
videos.overview: Hoffs enrolls in a teen modeling school after several of its graduates end up appearing in pornography.

videos.title: Mean Streets and Pastel Houses
videos.overview: Hanson goes undercover as a punk rocker in an effort to stop a feud between two rival gangs from turning into a war.

videos.title: In the Custody of a Clown
videos.overview: The Jump Street unit discovers that a boy who was being used as a pawn by his feuding parents faked his kidnapping with the aid of his grandfather to get away from his parents.

videos.title: Besieged (1)
videos.overview: Hanson and Hoffs go undercover in order to put a crack ring out of business. Penhall, working on the same case, returns to squad car and becomes convinced that his new partner killed a drug pusher.

videos.title: Besieged (2)
videos.overview: Hanson and Hoffs go undercover in order to put a crack ring out of business. Penhall, working on the same case, returns to squad car and becomes convinced that his new partner killed a drug pusher.

videos.title: Two for the Road
videos.overview: The Jump Street unit is investigating a counterfeit drivers license ring when Captain Fuller gets arrested for drunk driving.

videos.title: After School Special
videos.overview: Hanson is unable to keep his mind on the investigation of a shooting of a teacher at an inner city school when he learns that his mother is moving in with her boyfriend.

videos.title: Higher Education
videos.overview: A pregnant school girl fingers Ioki as the father to be.

videos.title: Don't Stretch the Rainbow
videos.overview: Racial violence threatens to break out at an integrated school when word leaks out that a white student got a black student pregnant.

videos.title: Honor Bound
videos.overview: Hanson and Penhall find the military code of honor hampering their undercover investigation of a military academy where the cadets are suspected of killing homosexuals.

videos.title: You Ought to Be in Prison
videos.overview: Hanson and a film star he had been assigned to protect are kidnapped by an escaped murderer.

videos.title: How Much is That Body in the Window?
videos.overview: Penhall gets close to a football player suspected of using steroids at a school where an olympic hopeful gymnast died after a performance due to steroid abuse. Hanson considers becoming a big brother.

videos.title: Christmas in Saigon
videos.overview: Ioki faces being dismissed from the force when internal affairs discovers that he is a Vietnamese refuge who is using an alias. Flashback sequences show his escape from Saigon.

videos.title: Fear and Loathing with Russell Buckins
videos.overview: Hanson contemplates leaving the force and leaves town instead of going to a refresher course at the police academy he and Penhall had been assigned to take after they went drag racing to try to catch a hit and run driver.

videos.title: A Big Disease with a Little Name
videos.overview: Dorothy an old girlfriend of Penhall's, who walked out on him two years ago, returns and decides to move in with him. Hanson gets assigned to protect a student with AIDS who is being made to feel unwelcome in class.

videos.title: Chapel of Love
videos.overview: Past romances that didn't have happy endings are the subject of conversation at a Valentine Day Eve poker game.

videos.title: I'm OK, You Need Work
videos.overview: Hanson becomes trapped in a private drug clinic where he had himself placed in order to investigate claims of patient abuse made by a kid he once busted on drug charges.

videos.title: Orpheus 3.3
videos.overview: Hanson blames himself for failing to prevent the shooting death of his girlfriend in a convenience store robbery and becomes obsessed with revenge.

videos.title: Champagne High
videos.overview: Penhall & Hanson go undercover as the McQuaid brothers in a suburban high school, that recently has had inner city kids bused in, to investigate the theft of a Porsche. Meanwhile, Judy must deal with a love-sick teenage boy.

videos.title: Brother Hanson & the Miracle of Renner's Pond
videos.overview: When a small-town teacher refuses to teach the theory of evolution after his son has a near-death experience, Hanson infiltrates the school to try to discover who's behind the recent burning of the science books.

videos.title: Raising Marijuana
videos.overview: Penhall and Ioki go undercover as the ""Swark Twins"" to get in with teenage boys working for drug smugglers. Meanwhile, Hoffs becomes romantically involved with the head drug smuggler.

videos.title: Best Years of Your Life
videos.overview: The suicide of a popular student, whom Hanson and Penhall had arrested the night before, leaves his family, fellow students and Hanson in a state of depression and forces Penhall to relive bitter childhood memories.

videos.title: Cory and Dean Got Married
videos.overview: Hoffs and Penhall must deal with a pursuing husband when they are assigned to escort a girl arrested for killing her father when he tried to prevent her from eloping.

videos.title: School's Out
videos.overview: Hanson goes undercover to find a student who is blowing up toilets. Meanwhile, Fuller must convince the higher-ups that the Jump Street program, which is scheduled to be deactivated over the summer, should be reactivated in the fall, and Doug decides it's time to grow up.

videos.title: Fun with Animals
videos.overview: Hanson is assigned Booker as his new partner and the two don't hit it off as Booker's racist attitudes lead Hanson to believe that Booker raped a black student.

videos.title: Slippin' Into Darkness
videos.overview: Hoffs and Ioki go undercover in a Guardian Angel-type street patrol whose members have a vendetta out for a drug dealer who Hanson is trying to set up for a bust.

videos.title: The Currency We Trade In
videos.overview: A popular sports writer finds his whole life ruined when Penhall believes his ex-wife's allegations of his being a child molester.

videos.title: Coach of the Year
videos.overview: Penhall and Booker join a high school football team in attempt to prove that the coach's negligence led to the paralyzing injury of one of the players.

videos.title: Whose Choice is it Anyways?
videos.overview: Hoffs goes undercover as a pregnant teen to investigate threats of violence being made to a family planning center by anti-abortionists.

videos.title: Hell Week
videos.overview: Hanson and Ioki must endure hell week as fraternity pledges in order to gain the confidence and get evidence on a gang rape which occurred at a frat party.

videos.title: The Dragon and the Angel
videos.overview: While working undercover in a Vietnamese streetgang, Ioki learns of a communist businessman who may be able to help his grandmother who is still in Vietnam.

videos.title: Blu Flu
videos.overview: Everyone in the Jump Street unit gets blue flu when the police force goes on strike forcing Captain Fuller to team up with a rookie cadet.

videos.title: Swallowed Alive
videos.overview: Hanson becomes an inmate in a juvenile detention hall in order to investigate the murder of one of the inmates.

videos.title: What About Love?
videos.overview: Dorothy and Penhall split up forcing Penhall to move in with Ioki. Hoffs becomes involved with a city inspector, who is auditing Jump Street's records.

videos.title: Woolly Bullies
videos.overview: Penhall's encounter with a bully while undercover causes the members of the Jump Street unit to reminisce about their dealings with bullies while they were in school.

videos.title: The Dreaded Return of Russell Buckins
videos.overview: Hanson goes after an old friend who wrote an article exposing the Jump Street program causing Hanson to get suspended from duty.

videos.title: A.W.O.L.
videos.overview: An old Army buddy comes to Fuller seeking the Jump Street unit's help in bringing in an AWOL soldier who will be classified a deserter if he doesn't return to base within two days.

videos.title: Nemesis
videos.overview: Booker is laiden with guilt when after he infiltrates a gang of drug users that kill one of their own whom they suspect is an undercover cop.

videos.title: Fathers and Sons
videos.overview: Fuller and the Jump Street unit are given a lot of flak and told to pull off the case when city hall learns Hanson and Penhall are about to bust the mayor's son on drug dealing charges.

videos.title: High High
videos.overview: The Jump Street cops enroll in a performing arts school to bust a drug ring being run there.

videos.title: Blinded by the Thousand Points of Light
videos.overview: Undercover looking for a person who has been preying on homeless teens, the Jump Street cops learn what it is really like to live on the street.

videos.title: Next Victim
videos.overview: Booker goes undercover as a radio DJ to discover who killed a controversial college radio personality by planting a bomb in his car.

videos.title: Loc'd Out (1)
videos.overview: Hanson finds himself on the wrong side of the law after he decides to seek revenge on members of a street gang who shot and seriously wounded Ioki.

videos.title: Loc'd Out (2)
videos.overview: Hanson finds himself on the wrong side of the law after he decides to seek revenge on members of a street gang who shot and seriously wounded Ioki.

videos.title: Draw the Line
videos.overview: Booker resigns from the police force after solving a case that gets Hanson out of prison.

videos.title: Say It Ain't So, Pete
videos.overview: Penhall gets caught up in the excitement as he and Hanson go undercover to bust a college gambling operation.

videos.title: Eternal Flame
videos.overview: Hanson meets an old flame now married to the owner of a 80's nightclub suspected of providing LSD to high school students.

videos.title: Come from the Shadows
videos.overview: Penhall finds himself falling for an illegal immigrant from El Salvador when the Jump Street unit is sent in to investigate a priest suspected of selling babies.

videos.title: God is a Bullet
videos.overview: The Jump Street team intervenes when a tough new principal goes too far in his attempts to clean up a drug and crime infested inner city school.

videos.title: Old Haunts in a New Age
videos.overview: During a Halloween string of high school fires, Hanson becomes a bit skeptical of a teen age psychic claiming to be able to predict where the next fire will occur.

videos.title: Out of Control
videos.overview: Penhall and Ioki become rent a cops while Hanson becomes a member of a clique of thrill seeking kids who break into houses to annoy the rent a cops.

videos.title: Stand by Your Man
videos.overview: While trying to expose a drug ring at a prestigious medical school, Hoffs is raped while on a date with one of the suspects who later claims that she seduced him.

videos.title: Mike's P.O.V.
videos.overview: Hanson and Penhall investigate the murder of a high school teacher's wife and discover that the teacher hired one of his students to kill her.

videos.title: Wheels and Deals (II)
videos.overview:
Working on a tip from Booker, the Jump Street cops join a motorcycle caravan in order to bring Raymond Crane to justice.

The crossover starts on Booker S01E08 Deals and Wheels (I).

videos.title: Parental Guidance Suggested
videos.overview: While observing a family suspected of operating a burglary ring, Hoffs begins to suspect that a boy is being abused.

videos.title: Things We Said Today
videos.overview: Ioki is confronted by a teenage boy with a gun, who three years earlier Ioki had talked into turning in his drug abusing family.

videos.title: Research and Destroy
videos.overview: The Jump Street Cops are sent to investigate a college chemistry lab where it is suspected that new designer drugs are being manufactured.

videos.title: A Change of Heart
videos.overview: A lesbian student makes a pass at Hoffs when she and Capt. Fuller go undercover at a high school to learn the identity of a student who was a witness to a teacher's murder.

videos.title: Back from the Future
videos.overview: In the 21st century a young cop hoping to revive the Jump Street program interviews the retired officers who were there when it all started.
Hanson tries to convince a juvenile inmate on death row to appear in a film intended to keep his peers out of prison.

videos.title: Hi Mom
videos.overview: Hanson and Penhall expose a point shaving scheme when they go undercover to investigate the drug related death of a college basketball star.

videos.title: Awomp-Bomp-Aloobomb, Aloop Bamboom
videos.overview: Hanson and Penhall find a way to get out of the cold while remaining on the job as they trail a suspected bomber to Florida during spring break.

videos.title: La Bizca
videos.overview: Penhall ends up taking his nephew back to America after he and Hanson travel to El Salvador in order to find Penhall's wife, whom they learn was killed in the fighting.

videos.title: Last Chance High
videos.overview: Donning their McQuaid brother aliases for one last time Hanson and Penhall discover a teenage girl who has kidnapped her baby sister to get her away from their abusive parents; while Penhall adjusts to becoming a father figure.

videos.title: Unfinished Business
videos.overview: A handicapped policewoman asks Fuller to send her undercover to investigate a series of attacks on handicapped women; however, Fuller also send in Hoffs in a wheelchair.

videos.title: Shirts and Skins
videos.overview: When the leader of a neo-Nazi group is murdered, Hoffs & Ioki go undercover in the liberal group suspected of the killing. While Penhall joins the Nazis to learn if they plan a violent reprisal.

videos.title: How I Saved the Senator
videos.overview: The Jump Street cops each relate a different version (with the teller as the hero of a film from their favorite genre), to a reporter investigating the foiled attempt to kill a senator.

videos.title: Rounding Third
videos.overview: After volunteering to become a Little League coach Penhall learns that one of the players was kidnapped by his father, from his mother and step-father.

videos.title: Everyday is Christmas
videos.overview: After botching an assignment, Penhall is transferred to a different precinct where he learns the cops routinely accept bribes and finds himself the subject of a Jump Street investigation.

videos.title: Blackout
videos.overview: Hoffs, Hanson and Penhall find themselves at the mercy of a defiant gang when all of them become trapped inside a school with out power.

videos.title: Tunnel of Love
videos.overview: Hoffs and Garrett must deal with a DEA officer while working undercover at a massage parlor suspected of being a front for a drug operation.

videos.title: Back to School
videos.overview: Garrett attempts to infiltrate a high school drug ring by dating the sister of the ring's suspected leader.

videos.title: Buddy System
videos.overview: McCann joins up to be the partner of a mentally handicapped youth in a school buddy system, to investigate the murder of the boy's former partner.

videos.title: Poison
videos.overview: Doug falls for a narcotics officer with questionable tactics and a possible drug problem herself.

videos.title: Just Say No! High
videos.overview: Hoffs is suspended from the force when while working undercover in high school she is forced to take a mandatory drug test and the results come back positive.

videos.title: Brothers
videos.overview: Doug has a strained reunion with his estranged younger brother Joey when Joey is assigned to the Jump St. team. Doug comes to his aid after Joey is brainwashed into joining a religious cult he was investigating.

videos.title: This Ain't No Summer Camp
videos.overview: Doug and Joey enroll in a wilderness camp for troubled teams to investigate a murder that happened there and find themselves constantly in trouble with the ex-marine who runs the place.

videos.title: The Girl Next Door
videos.overview: While investigating the hit and run murder of a high school football star, McCann becomes involved with a cheerleader who has AIDS.

videos.title: Diplomas for Sale
videos.overview: Doug and Joey enroll in a college where good students are mysteriously being turned into criminals.

videos.title: Number One with A Bullet
videos.overview: Doug is seriously wounded while on a case and while the doctors try to save his life he enters limbo where the people he meets there cause him to reconsider his choice of career.

videos.title: Equal Protection
videos.overview: After discovering that some white officers are responsible for beating and harassing black teenagers, Hoffs, with Fuller's help, try to convict them.

videos.title: The Education of Terry Carver
videos.overview: Hoffs, Joey and Mac help a raped girl that has no proof to convict the attacker.

videos.title: Baby Blues
videos.overview: Joey feels responsible for a baby girl he is taking care in a experimental program and try to find her drug addicted mother.

videos.title: Film at Eleven
videos.overview: After finding the missing daughter of a famous reporter, Mac tries to solve the mistery behind the missing.

videos.title: In the Name of Love
videos.overview: Mac has to date a daughter of a reputed drug dealer in a confidential FBI case at the same time he is trying to rebuild a relantionship with an old flame.

videos.title: Coppin' Out
videos.overview: Mac and Joey try to find the responsibles for vandalizing elderly homes. The problem is that one of the prime suspects is the son of Fuller's girlfriend.

videos.title: Under the Influence
videos.overview: McCann infiltrates a group of devil worshipers whose leader has enthralled a teenage boy with her beauty.

videos.title: Crossfire
videos.overview: Hoffs is charged in a civil suit for a man she has arrested for solicitation. At court, she has to confront the man and his representative, her boyfriend's vindictive ex-wife.

videos.title: Wasted
videos.overview: Mac goes undercover as a football player when a high school football star dies from an unexplained heart attack.

videos.title: Bad Day at Blackburn
videos.overview: Fuller, Hoffs and Mac go undercover to investigate a gang of high school extortionists operating in a high school.

videos.title: Homegirls
videos.overview: After seeing a teenager being murdered, Hoffs infiltrates the girl's street gang to find out who killed her.

videos.title: Second Chances
videos.overview: Hoffs and Mac investigate a car theft ring near a high school, and the prime suspect is a pupil of Hoffs.
